description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Approved the acquisitions of the immovable properties in Banbaragama, Bandarawela D/S Division, Badulla District for the constructions under Makul Ella Water Supply Scheme and in Katuwangoda, Malimbada D/S Division, Matara District for the constructions under Matara Stage IV Water Supply Project
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for public infrastructure projects (water supply schemes). It involves the acquisition of specific immovable properties described in detailed schedules, including land boundaries, locations, and claimant information. While it references a minister and a legal act, the core subject matter is land acquisition and property description, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
